author: Nellyslife
title: HIRING: Freelance Illustrator & Graphic Designer (Philippines)
content: HIRING: Freelance Illustrator & Graphic Designer (Philippines). Remote · Project-based · Start ASAP. Apply by email only: team.nellyslife@gmail.com. Send your portfolio, rates and availability, with the subject line “Freelance Illustrator / Designer – [Your Name]”. DMs and comments won’t be considered. Please read the requirements in the graph below BEFORE applying to this job. Overview: We are seeking a versatile Illustrator to join our team on a contract basis. This role will involve creating high-quality designs for our products. Key Details: Remote Work Setup Minimum of 1 to 3 months, with the possibility of renewal at the discretion of the Creative Director. Starting at Php 35,000 for the first month, with the potential to increase to Php 45,000 for future contracts based on performance and design quality. Responsibilities: Create a number of high-quality small designs per week based on provided concept statements and your own creative ideas. Collaborate with the team to ensure designs meet expectations and align with the project's vision. Review feedback and make necessary adjustments to designs as required. Attached Reference: https://heyzine.com/flip-book/f88cd30909.html#page/1. Please send your portfolio to: nhjumaoas@gmail.com

author: Geek Realm Hub
title: The Pokémon Company is hiring a full-time Pokémon Sleep illustrator
content: The Pokémon Company is hiring a full-time Pokémon Sleep illustrator! Dream job alert for Pokémon artists! The Pokémon Company has opened a full-time illustrator position focused on creating artwork for Pokémon Sleep. The role includes designing Pokémon sleeping poses using vector illustrations, creating in-game assets such as items, dishes, and environments, checking artwork quality, and directing external illustrators. Applicants need at least two years of professional vector illustration experience, proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, experience matching established character and IP art styles, and a background in the gaming or entertainment industry. The position is based at The Pokémon Company's headquarters in Roppongi, Tokyo, Japan. Apply at: https://hrmos.co/pages/pokemon/jobs/0000147
